subject: general
question: What is the primary objective of preventive maintenance?

options.text: Delaying repairs until a breakdown occurs.
Eliminating the need for regular inspections

solution:
The correct answer is __Reducing unexpected equipment failures**(Option 1)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Preventive maintenance__ is performed regularly to reduce equipment failures.
 
• Its primary goal is to ensure equipment reliability and avoid unplanned downtime.
 
• Regular inspections, cleaning, lubrication, and adjustments are included.
 
• It helps increase operational efficiency and extend the lifespan of equipment.
 
• Preventive maintenance reduces repair costs by addressing issues before they become critical.
 
• Unlike reactive maintenance, it proactively addresses potential problems.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Reactive Maintenance:**

 
 
• Performed only after equipment breaks down.
 
• Often results in higher repair costs and downtime.
 
 
 
• **Condition-Based Maintenance:**
 
 
• Uses monitoring tools to determine when maintenance is needed.
 
• Reduces unnecessary maintenance activities.
 
 
 
• **Predictive Maintenance:**
 
 
• Uses data analysis and sensors to predict equipment failures.
 
• Enables timely intervention before breakdowns occur.
